youtube.title: Why Pringles Are Shaped Like A Saddle 🥔 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Pringles are shaped as a hyperbolic paraboloid, a saddle that curves up in one direction and down in the other. The double curve spreads force so a thin crisp is stiffer and less likely to snap, and identical shapes nest in a stack, so they can be packed tightly in a tube.
